stages.title: Core Programming — control flow, functions, collections and state
Structured Program Design — modules, files, iterators and OOP
Robustness — exceptions, testing, debugging and reproducibility

competencies.title: Syntax and expression fluency
evidence: read and explain a short expression
write a small expression with expected value

competencies.title: Data model and type reasoning
evidence: predict type/truthiness/equality behavior
explain mutable versus immutable behavior

competencies.title: Control-flow reasoning
evidence: predict branch/loop execution
write bounded conditional and iterative logic

competencies.title: Function decomposition and contracts
evidence: decompose a task into functions
explain parameters, return values and side effects

competencies.title: Collections and iteration
evidence: choose list/tuple/dict/set appropriately
iterate and transform collections correctly

competencies.title: Name binding, references and mutation
evidence: predict aliasing/mutation effects
distinguish identity from equality where relevant

competencies.title: Exceptions and error handling
evidence: diagnose exception flow
handle only recoverable failures

competencies.title: Modules, imports and namespace boundaries
evidence: split code into modules
explain import namespace and side-effect risks

competencies.title: Files and data interchange
evidence: read/write text data with context managers
process JSON/CSV with explicit error handling

competencies.title: Iterables, iterators, generators and comprehensions
evidence: distinguish iterable from iterator
explain generator state/exhaustion

competencies.title: Python object model and OOP basics
evidence: design a small class with justified responsibilities
prefer composition/inheritance appropriately

competencies.title: Type hints and dataclasses
evidence: use annotations without treating them as runtime enforcement
use dataclass when it reduces boilerplate without hiding semantics

competencies.title: Testing and debugging
evidence: write behavior-focused tests
reproduce, isolate and explain a defect

competencies.title: Environment, package and reproducibility literacy
evidence: describe interpreter/environment/package roles
reproduce a known project state from declared dependencies

competencies.title: Scientific/data Python bridge
evidence: perform a small array/dataframe transformation
state where statistics/ML/database theory is externally owned

competencies.title: Engineering project transfer
evidence: deliver a reproducible Python project artifact
explain design, tests, limitations and transfer to research/engineering context
